title: BusBuddy: Route and Timetable Planner
context: City bus apps answer 'when is the next bus?' and help operators plan trips and depots along a corridor.
input: Sorted departures per stop; passenger counts; trip windows; depot candidates.

milestones.title: Busiest boarding stop
milestones.requirement: Boardings per stop with a count array.

milestones.title: Routes through the grid
milestones.requirement: Count monotone routes avoiding closed roads (memo DP).

milestones.title: Passengers on board
milestones.requirement: Boardings/alightings along the route via a difference array.

milestones.title: Depot spacing
milestones.requirement: Place 3 depots on candidate markers maximising the minimum gap.

milestones.title: Operating hours
milestones.requirement: Merge overlapping service windows into operating hours.
